name: Binomial coefficients
description: Count the ways to choose which k of n positions get a label; C(n,k).

name: Complementary counting
description: Count what you do not want and subtract from the total.

name: Multiplication principle
description: Split a path or outcome at a forced waypoint and multiply the counts of the pieces.
aliases: product rule, split at a point

name: Reflection principle
description: Paths that touch a barrier biject with unrestricted paths to the endpoint reflected across it.

name: Catalan numbers
description: C_n = C(2n,n)/(n+1): Dyck paths, ballot sequences, balanced brackets, binary trees.

name: Stars and bars / compositions
description: Split n identical items into k ordered positive (or non-negative) parts: C(n-1,k-1).

name: Inclusion-exclusion
description: Alternate-sign sum over intersections to count a union.

name: Symmetry and pairing
description: Exhibit a bijection between two outcome sets to show they are equally likely, with no computation.

name: Recurrences
description: Condition on the first or last step to write a_n in terms of smaller cases.
aliases: recursion, recursive counting, dp, dynamic programming

name: First-step analysis
description: Condition on the first move of a Markov chain and solve the resulting linear equations.
aliases: markov chain, states, conditioning on the first flip

name: Linearity of expectation
description: E[sum] = sum of E, dependence or not; usually via indicator variables.

name: Geometric waiting times
description: Trials until the first success: E = 1/p.

name: Martingales and optional stopping
description: A fair game stopped at a bounded time has expected value equal to its start.
